# Third-party 3D asset

`urban-apartments-facade.glb` is an optimized web derivative of
“Modular Urban Apartments Facade” by James Ray Cock, downloaded from
[Poly Haven](https://polyhaven.com/a/modular_urban_apartments_facade).

The source asset is provided under the
[CC0 1.0 Universal license](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).
It was converted to a single GLB, compressed with Meshopt, and its textures
were converted to WebP for use on this website.
